description: This Java class 'ReadableShopOrder' extends 'ReadableOrder' and implements 'Serializable'. It models a shop order with properties such as shipping summary, error message, order totals, and grand total. It includes getters and setters for these properties.

classes.name: ReadableShopOrder
classes.description: A class representing a readable view of a shop order, including financial summaries and shipping info.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the global error message associated with the order.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the global error message for the order.

methods.name: getGrandTotal
methods.description: Retrieves the grand total amount of the order.

methods.name: setGrandTotal
methods.description: Sets the grand total amount of the order.

methods.name: getSubTotals
methods.description: Retrieves the list of subtotal components of the order.

methods.name: setSubTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of subtotal components of the order.
